craft_notes: Sthāyin: Prakrit seal 1 — fearless in the made-firm transaction. Sanskrit-first (Prakrit): daḍha-pasiddhi-ghaḍie kept fused-print; soi asmi kept that-very-I-am (Prakrit pronouns kept, glossed in L0); ṇīsaṃko kept fearless (Prakrit niṣaṅka). Rows: 9 (transaction/fearless pair), 1 ('fearless' closes — niṣaṅka end-weight), 6 (Prakrit kept as Prakrit — register shift IS the seal's texture). Close: 'that very I am fearless.' Rejected: translating into Sanskrit — killed: the Prakrit is the text; 'confident' — killed: niṣaṅka is fearless (no-doubt-armed).
